newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CNBC to air Sakakibara interview at 1000 GMT.
newsitem.headline: CNBC to air Sakakibara interview at 1000 GMT.

text.p: Cable television network CNBC said it would air an interview with Eisuke Sakakibara, director of the International Finance Bureau in Japan's Finance Ministry, at 1000 GMT on Monday.
A Japanese finance ministry official contacted in Tokyo told Reuters that Sakakibara would not speak about currency movements.
CNBC said Sakakibara would discuss how time is running out for Japanese financial institutions in the run up to "Big Bang"-style financial reforms.
He argued that Japanese institutions are not yet ready for impending reforms and predicted that the Big Bang would happen much faster than investors expect, CNBC said.
